text:
lina: Thanks again for joining the all-hands — leaving this thread for follow-ups on sales pipeline, GTM priorities, and partner asks. Drop any clarifying Qs and leadership will chime in.

raj: Quick top-line on pipeline: committed coverage ≈ 3.2x target for next quarter, top 10 deals account for ~55% of value. Average sales cycle is 75 days right now. We're still seeing concentration in mid-market ACV bands.

taylor: Can you share the updated playbook slide for rep-level asks? Reps asked for clear language on partner-sourced vs partner-assisted credit.

raj: Yep — sending a trimmed deck in a follow-up. TL;DR: partner-sourced = full credit, partner-assisted = 30% credit unless joint-demo >2 execs. Will post the slide.

sara: Partner update: pilot for partner-led incentives starts next month with three ISV partners. We'll track partner-led pipeline separately and run enablement sessions week after next. Partner portal beta link will be shared with partner PMs by Fri.

mike: From product side, the partner integration APIs for single-sign demo & token routing are on track for the middle of Q2. That should remove the manual demo handoffs that slow partner-close.

eve: For Dedicated customers onboarding: what's the SLA for ramping capacity once a deal is signed? We need to set expectations with renewals/CS teams.

raj: @eve Good call — standard is 10 business days for baseline configs, 20 for air-gapped. We'll add these to the playbook.

morgan: Quick ask: does anyone have recent win-rate split for partner-led vs rep-led? Want to see if incentives are paying off.

sara: Latest cohort (last quarter) shows ~28% win rate for partner-led vs ~12% for rep-led for comparable ACV bands. Small sample but promising — will produce a deck with cohort analysis.

taylor: Playbook draft + assets (slides, email templates, demo checklist) are here: https://redwood-internal.example.com/playbooks/gp-qt. Snippet: 
```
- sales-deck: sales-deck-q2.pdf
- enablement: partner-playbook-v1.md
- templates: partner-intro-email.md
```

lina: Action items to capture: 1) raj to post trimmed slides (owner: raj, due: Tue EOD) 2) sara to share partner portal beta and cohort deck (owner: sara, due: Fri) 3) taylor to finalize playbook assets and push to sales enablement (owner: taylor, due: Wed) 4) mike to confirm API demo timeline and send blurb for enablement (owner: mike, due: Thu).

raj: I'll also run a 30-min sync with sales leadership to prioritize top-20 deals for playbook outreach. Will invite reps and partner PMs.

morgan: Can we add a simple tracker column in the CRM for "partner-involved" + "partner-credit" so reporting is easier?

taylor: Yes — creating a CRM field today. Will notify ops.

sara: Also thinking about a lightweight incentive: $2k co-sell fund per qualified partner-sourced closed-won in pilot. Details in the upcoming deck.

eve: For CS: can we get an onboarding checklist for Dedicated so we can pre-assign CSM hours? That'll keep ramp consistent.

mike: I'll add a short README for the demo integration + security checklist for CSMs.

ci-bot: Recording and transcript from the all-hands are available: https://redwood-internal.example.com/recordings/1832001234 (recording uploaded)

lina: Thanks everyone — great momentum. If you need me to reassign any action items or nudge folks, ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
